sehemu: Part IV: High Court of Zanzibar
jina: Jurisdiction of the High Court of Zanzibar
maudhui: (1) Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 83 and 116 of this Constitution, the jurisdiction of the High Court of Zanzibar shall be as prescribed by the laws applicable in Zanzibar. (2) Without prejudice to this Constitution or any other law enacted by Parliament, where any law enacted by Parliament which applies to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar confers any power upon the High Court, the High Court of Zanzibar may exercise that power to the same extent as the High Court of the United Republic.
vifungu: (1) Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 83 and 116 of this Constitution, the jurisdiction of the High Court of Zanzibar shall be as prescribed by the laws applicable in Zanzibar.

(2) Without prejudice to this Constitution or any other law enacted by Parliament, where any law enacted by Parliament which applies to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar confers any power upon the High Court, the High Court of Zanzibar may exercise that power to the same extent as the High Court of the United Republic.
